brain_consensus.narrative: Bitcoin options skew widened to 23.81 volatility points from 20.5 on the October 18 expiry. The figure is the implied volatility on a put about ten percent below bitcoin minus the implied volatility on a call about ten percent above it, so a wider print means money is paying more for downside protection than for upside. The 73,000 put is marked at 63.06 implied volatility against 39.25 on the 89,000 call, with bitcoin at 81k, and the call strike in that reading moved from 90,000 to 89,000.
brain_consensus.headline: Bitcoin Options Skew Widened To 23.81 Volatility Points From 20.5
